info.longName: WisdomTree Europe Quality Dividend Growth Fund

funds_data.description: At least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in constituent securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such constituent securities. The index consists of dividend-paying common stocks of companies with growth characteristics that are incorporated and listed on a stock exchange in one of the following countries: Germany, Switzerland, United Kingdom, etc. The fund is non-diversified.
